purpose: Keep candidate JavaScript out of the trusted node:test process while exercising both package-root exports through a bounded JSON request/response boundary.

operations.call: Import the package root, select only default or dedent, and call it once with one JSON-compatible value. Return a string result or a bounded exception record.
operations.inventory: Package name, version, ESM export, declarations, dependency closure, and lifecycle restrictions are validated by the candidate installer and package checks.

in_scope_values: primitive strings containing LF or CRLF line endings
JSON-compatible non-string values for the TypeError contract
